name: context-handoff-connection-race
description: Tier-P F1 repro rig for github/copilot-agent-runtime#22266: a single session that discovers the context-handoff plugin from TWO sources at once -- the marketplace-installed copy AND a byte-identical duplicate present as a project-level extension in the working repo -- launches BOTH as real connections under one real headed (tmux-driven) session, and the second one hits validate_external_tools' same-session tool-name clash (generate_handoff_prompt/save_handoff_prompt/consume_handoff/trigger_handoff already registered by another connection). Report-only repro rig, not a regression gate: it asserts the clash IS observed (proving the mechanism), and flags loudly if it stops reproducing (either fixed upstream, or the container's layout/log-naming assumptions diverged).

provisioned_by_flow: tmux (apt, required -- extensions only load under a real headed session)

expected_artifacts: cr-logs/tmux-pane.log (captured pane output of the driven headed session)
~/.copilot/logs/extensions/*context-handoff* (per-connection extension logs; asserted for the tool-name-clash text)

stages.title: duplicate the extension as a project-level source in the working repo
run one HEADED session against BOTH sources; both extensions launch
assert the tool-name clash on the second (losing) connection
